exposure: type of treatment received (partial/complete/given up after birth)
outcome: survival status (at hospital discharge or 40 weeks corrected gestational age)
survival rate without major serious disease
cohort: The study included 2004 extremely preterm infants with gestational ages between 22-27+6 weeks born in the southwest area of Fujian province, China.
finding: The all-cause mortality of extremely preterm infants in the southwest area of Fujian Province remains high, significantly influenced by a large number of infants being given up after birth in the delivery room, though survival rates for those receiving complete treatment at 25-27 weeks were similar to developed countries.
followup_time: until hospital discharge or 40 weeks corrected gestational age
